gate_contract: Fixed before trained runs: finite outputs; scalar abs error <= .006 + 2*dtype epsilon*abs(reference), no scalar cosine gate; SPLADE nonnegative, cosine>=.999, relativeL2<=.05, exact nonzero supportJaccard>=.95. All gates required.
head: splade

serialization_metadata.operation: Offline lossless state_dict serialization only; no model execution/inference

scope: Actual pretrained tensors; authentic query/document pairs with token types and special separators; shape extensions repeat lexical document tokens, no PAD. Scalar compares raw identity logits, never sign-only cosine. SPLADE compares full vocabulary values and exact positive supports. Both GPU assignments; tokenization excluded.
